name: capon_matched
aim: Matched CAP-ON twin of capoff_floor (EM_CAP=1, eta=-1, 200 steps) to check whether the >0 rise emerges at the same early window and whether the WP has reached the CAP.
method: identical to capoff_floor but CAP ON (eta=-1); 200 steps, t=8 a.u.

advisor_verdict.probe_reading: At t=8 a.u. CAP-on and CAP-off are indistinguishable (dE final -0.016 vs -0.015 eV, neither >0). WP density_l2 DECAYS 0.052->0.001 (dispersing, NOT yet reaching CAP at z=+/-32.5). Confirms the caveat: 200 steps pre-dates WP arrival at the CAP, so absorption has not begun and the CAP cannot yet source energy. Extended run capon_reach (700 steps, t=28 a.u.) launched to let the WP reach the CAP.
